warnings: REVIEWED SCREENING DRAFT: primary Gazette sources and contextual gates added; not a complete legal consolidation or approved enforcement instrument. Stable IDs retained; citation text is a screening paraphrase. See docs/LEGAL_SOURCE_MATRIX.md. Original pack archived as 2026.09.07-draft; the preceding pack as 2026.09.07-legal-review-1. This version adds `plain` and `plain_action` to every rule: an inspector-facing description of what the rule is about and the one thing to do while it is open. No applicability condition, assertion, threshold, severity, assurance tier, source or statutory message differs from 2026.09.07-legal-review-1, so no verdict either pack can reach has changed; the version is new because the pack's bytes are, which is the only claim a version makes. The citation and its screening paraphrase remain the record and the notice text. This version additionally adds four screens that were previously unrepresented: the dimension the net quantity is expressed in (Rule 6(1)(c) with Rule 13), the currency of the retail sale price (Rule 6(1)(e)), the locality components of the declared address (Rule 6(1)(a) with Rule 10), and the best-before/use-by declaration a confirmed food package carries under its own labelling regime, which the packaged-commodities date rule refers to rather than replaces. Each is a narrow presence or form screen over evidence the pipeline already extracts; none re-interprets an existing rule, and the eighteen earlier rule IDs and their semantics are unchanged.
